title: Semantic model
help: Steward keeps the governed copy of the product’s Apache Ossie semantic model: stored as written, every save a version, signed off by a second person. Metrics are defined in dbt, Snowflake semantic views or BI tools – Steward drafts none.
validToday: Valid today: version {{version}}, signed off by {{by}} on {{date}}
noValid: No version is signed off yet.
signOffHelp: You sign off the text shown here (SHA-256 {{sha}}). From today it is the valid version of the semantic model. Who saved or proposed a version cannot sign it off.
ownVersion: You saved or proposed this version: a second person signs it off.

validOn.title: Which model was valid on a day?
validOn.valid: Version {{version}} – signed off by {{by}}, valid from {{from}}
validOn.none: No version was signed off and valid on {{date}}.

lintNone: No findings against the official schema.
driftNone: No drift: the datasets match the product’s bound elements and contracts.
driftHidden_one: {{count}} bound contract you may not see was not used.
driftHidden_other: {{count}} bound contracts you may not see were not used.
driftChecked_one: Columns known for {{count}} dataset (a bound contract or a schema snapshot).
driftChecked_other: Columns known for {{count}} datasets (a bound contract or a schema snapshot).

findings.version: The document names no Ossie revision Steward knows ({{version}}) – checked against 0.1.1.
findings.sourceNotBound: The source of the dataset {{dataset}} ({{source}}) is no element bound to the product’s ports.
findings.columnMissingContract: The field {{field}} of {{dataset}} reads the column {{column}}, which is not in the bound contract.
findings.columnMissingSnapshot: The field {{field}} of {{dataset}} reads the column {{column}}, which is not in the schema snapshot.
findings.personalNoAiContext: The field {{field}} of {{dataset}} is personal data in the bound contract but has no ai_context note.
findings.metricUnknownField: The metric {{metric}} names {{field}} of {{dataset}}, which is no field of it.
findings.metricUnknownDataset: The metric {{metric}} names {{dataset}}, which is no dataset of the model.

noChanges: The two versions have the same text.

preview.title: Preview of {{name}}
preview.help: What the port carries, without reading a platform: the examples of the bound data contract and recorded responses. Steward reads no rows from Snowflake or SQL databases (metadata only).

preview.hiddenContract: A data contract you may not see is bound.
preview.hiddenRecordings_one: {{count}} on a platform you may not use
preview.hiddenRecordings_other: {{count}} on platforms you may not use
preview.masked: Masked: sensitive fields and the fields the bound contract marks personal.
preview.noPlatformRecordings: This platform has no recorded responses.
preview.unlinkConfirm: Unlink the recorded response {{name}} from this port

peek.title: Newest messages of {{name}}
peek.note: At most 5 messages of 4 KB, masked – also the fields that bound contracts mark personal. Every read is audited without its values. Only where the platform allows it, and only for its managers.
